sql: WITH gastos_legislativos AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_liquidado AS DECIMAL)) AS total_gastos FROM despesa_despesa WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 AND cod_orgao = '01') , receitas_correntes AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_realizadoateperiodo AS DECIMAL)) AS total_receitas FROM receita_receita WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 AND dsc_cateconomica ILIKE '%Corrente%') SELECT (total_gastos / NULLIF(total_receitas, 0)) * 100 AS porcentagem FROM gastos_legislativos, receitas_correntes;
